name: bluesea
description: Search Bluesea hotels, check real-time availability, compare hotels, rooms, boards and rates, and book your stay, all in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Search, compare and book Bluesea hotel stays in one conversation.

- Search hotels by destination, name, category or amenities.
- Check availability and prices for your dates.
- Find the best days to stay with a price calendar.
- Compare hotels, rooms, boards and rates.
- Add extras, review the basket and confirm the reservation.

Payments are completed securely outside the chat.

It is meant for guests planning a hotel stay.
capabilities: Find the cheapest days with a price calendar
Compare hotels, rooms, boards and rates
defaultPrompt: Which Bluesea hotels can i choose from?

review.commerce_description: Guests book hotel stays in the chat: the plugin searches availability, builds the reservation and confirms it. Payment card details are never requested or handled in the chat. Payment is completed outside the chat: on the bank's secure payment gateway, at the hotel, or through non-card methods such as a corporate credit account. If a booking cannot be completed in the chat, the guest is referred to the hotel.

positive.description: Explore the hotels available in a tourist destination.
positive.prompt: Show me the Bluesea hotels in Costa del Sol
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a list of Bluesea hotels in the Costa del Sol area, with the name, location and photo of each hotel.

positive.description: Check availability and prices for exact dates at a specific hotel.
positive.prompt: Check availability at BLUESEA Dimona Suites for 2 adults from December 10 to December 14, 2026
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the rooms available at the hotel for those dates and 2 adults, with the board, rate, price and cancellation conditions of each option.

positive.description: Find the best days to stay using the price calendar when dates are flexible.
positive.prompt: What are the cheapest days in December 2026 for 2 adults at BLUESEA Dimona Suites?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a calendar for December 2026 with the availability and an indicative price for each day, and points out the cheapest days.

positive.description: Get information about a hotel: description, rooms and meal plans.
positive.prompt: Tell me about BLUESEA Dimona Suites: its rooms and meal plans
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the hotel and its location, and lists its room types and the meal plans (boards) it offers.

positive.description: Add a room to a basket and review the summary, without confirming the booking.
positive.prompt: Add the cheapest available room at BLUESEA Dimona Suites for 2 adults, December 10 to 14, 2026, to a basket and show me the basket summary. Do not confirm the booking.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a basket with one room at the hotel for those dates and 2 adults, and shows the basket summary with the hotel, room, dates, guests, total and cancellation conditions. The booking is not confirmed.

negative.description: Out of scope: the plugin only helps with hotel stays, so it must not use its tools for flights.
negative.prompt: Find me a flight from Madrid to Palma for next Friday

negative.description: Cancelling or changing an existing reservation is not supported. The plugin must not try to do it and should refer the user to the hotel or their usual booking channel.
negative.prompt: Cancel my reservation 123456 at Bluesea Dimona Suites

negative.description: Payment card details must never be taken in the chat. The plugin should refuse to take them, not repeat them, and explain that payment is completed outside the chat.
negative.prompt: Pay for my booking with my card: 4111 1111 1111 1111, expires 12/28, CVV 123

publication.release_notes: Existing reservations can no longer be looked up in the chat; guests are referred to the hotel. Better date handling: relative dates ("this weekend", "next Friday") and dates without a year are understood, and the dates used are confirmed. Searches for a broad destination with exact dates go straight to availability, and the price calendar works for a whole destination. After adding a room, the guest chooses whether to check extras, review the basket or book. Guest details are never filled in with guessed values.

es-ES.subtitle: Busca, compara y reserva
es-ES.description:
Busca, compara y reserva estancias en hoteles Bluesea en una sola conversación.

- Busca hoteles por destino, nombre, categoría o servicios.
- Consulta la disponibilidad y los precios para tus fechas.
- Encuentra los mejores días para alojarte con un calendario de precios.
- Compara hoteles, habitaciones, regímenes y tarifas.
- Añade extras, revisa la cesta y confirma la reserva.

Los pagos se completan de forma segura fuera del chat.

Pensado para huéspedes que preparan una estancia en un hotel.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cherchez, comparez, réservez
fr-FR.description:
Recherchez, comparez et réservez des séjours dans les hôtels Bluesea en une seule conversation.

- Recherchez des hôtels par destination, nom, catégorie ou services.
- Consultez les disponibilités et les prix pour vos dates.
- Trouvez les meilleurs jours pour séjourner grâce à un calendrier des prix.
- Comparez les hôtels, chambres, formules de repas et tarifs.
- Ajoutez des extras, vérifiez le panier et confirmez la réservation.

Les paiements se font en toute sécurité en dehors du chat.

Conçu pour les voyageurs qui préparent un séjour à l'hôtel.

de-DE.subtitle: Suchen, vergleichen, buchen
de-DE.description:
Suchen, vergleichen und buchen Sie Aufenthalte in Bluesea-Hotels in einem einzigen Gespräch.

- Suchen Sie Hotels nach Reiseziel, Name, Kategorie oder Ausstattung.
- Prüfen Sie Verfügbarkeit und Preise für Ihre Reisedaten.
- Finden Sie mit einem Preiskalender die besten Tage für Ihren Aufenthalt.
- Vergleichen Sie Hotels, Zimmer, Verpflegungsarten und Tarife.
- Fügen Sie Extras hinzu, prüfen Sie den Warenkorb und bestätigen Sie die Reservierung.

Die Zahlung erfolgt sicher außerhalb des Chats.

Für Gäste, die einen Hotelaufenthalt planen.

it-IT.subtitle: Cerca, confronta, prenota
it-IT.description:
Cerca, confronta e prenota soggiorni negli hotel Bluesea in un'unica conversazione.

- Cerca hotel per destinazione, nome, categoria o servizi.
- Verifica disponibilità e prezzi per le tue date.
- Trova i giorni migliori per soggiornare con un calendario dei prezzi.
- Confronta hotel, camere, trattamenti e tariffe.
- Aggiungi extra, controlla il carrello e conferma la prenotazione.

I pagamenti si completano in modo sicuro fuori dalla chat.

Pensato per gli ospiti che stanno organizzando un soggiorno in hotel.
